data.claim: AgentConfig has no family knob, DDFLOW_AGENT_FAMILY is ignored, and a bare family name (an [agent].families value such as alibaba) is not accepted where a model id is: complete/reviewer_independence resolve it to the empty string and refuse the author.
data.falsifier: Config().agent.family existing, DDFLOW_AGENT_FAMILY honoured, or family_of(alibaba) answering alibaba would refute/seal the probe.
data.mechanism: complete author identity is only a model id (flag or session), and family_for recognises needle keys, not family values; nothing maps a bare family or a configured family to the author.
data.probe: python one-off setting DDFLOW_AGENT_FAMILY=deepseek then hasattr(Config().agent, family) and G.family_of(alibaba, Config())
data.probe_output: agent has family knob: False; env read as: AttributeError; family_of(alibaba): empty; accept FAMILY in place of a model: False
data.question: Can [agent].family / DDFLOW_AGENT_FAMILY stand in for a model id as the author identity complete and gate record judge?

evidence.note: CONFIRMED via python probe in the DX-author-family worktree: Config().agent has no family knob; DDFLOW_AGENT_FAMILY yields AttributeError; G.family_of("alibaba", Config()) is "" so complete refuses a bare-family author; no author_family channel exists (Rf678473511).

Ran ddflow brief --item DX-author-family and ddflow decision applicable DX-author-family. Governing: D-everything-configurable -> agent.family is a knob (file/CLI/MCP/prompt + env DDFLOW_AGENT_FAMILY, auto-derived); D-universal-principles r-reuse-core -> extend the one family_for/family_of engine, never a second map (tests/test_gate_record_family.py ratchets one implementation); D-small-files -> agent.py stays well under 20KB. Related fixed: B-complete-requires-model-even-when-recorded (author identity read back from events) and B1979dac602 (author-family model refused on reviewer gates).
